drhp.business: The Company processes and sells Vacuum Freeze Dried, Air-Dried, Frozen and IQF (Individually Quick Frozen) mushrooms, herbs, spices and fruits/vegetables, plus canned button mushrooms in shapes and sizes made to customer requirement. It grows premium Champignon mushrooms year-round under controlled atmospheric conditions and processes them at its own facilities. Output goes to domestic and international markets, mainly Europe, the USA, Canada and Australia, serving a diversified customer base across food-processing segments.

drhp.expansion: Flex Foods operates two manufacturing facilities — Dehradun, Uttarakhand and Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu (the Hosur plant) — covering freeze drying, air drying and IQF processing. The only physical addition disclosed for the year is a debottlenecking of the Hosur plant: to achieve full plant utilisation there the Company imported 30 trolleys with trays from China and built a Freezing Tunnel and an Ante room. risks.note: The MD&A opens by stating global activity 'now faces a major test from the outbreak of war in the Middle East', with slowdown in growth and higher inflation expected to be particularly pronounced in emerging market and developing economies, and that 'Downside risks dominate the outlook. A longer or broader conflict, worsening geopolitical fragmentation ... could significantly weaken growth and destabilize financial markets.'
risks.risk: Middle East conflict and geopolitical fragmentation

risks.note: Management notes US tariffs on India's merchandise exports increased from August 2025, that global trade 'is expected to decelerate further as inventories unwind and the impact of tariff intensifies', and that renewed trade tensions could significantly weaken growth. Material for a company whose sales are export-led to Europe, USA, Canada and Australia.
risks.risk: Tariff escalation and trade tensions, including US tariffs on Indian exports

risks.note: The MD&A devotes a section to the near-halt in shipments through the Strait of Hormuz disrupting crude, oil products and LNG flows, concluding that 'Elevated energy prices and supply chain disruptions will increase inflationary pressures, dampen private consumption, and erode investor confidence globally.' Freeze drying, air drying and IQF processing are energy-intensive.
risks.risk: Energy market disruption and input cost inflation

risks.note: Global growth is projected to slow to 2.6 percent in 2026 (World Bank Global Economic Prospects, January 2026) with the Middle East conflict creating additional headwinds, and Indian growth is projected to moderate to 6.6% in FY 2026-27 from 7.6% in FY 2025-26, reflecting those same headwinds.
risks.risk: Slowing global and Indian growth reducing end demand

risks.note: The Industry Scenario section names 'inflationary pressures, commodity price volatility, supply chain vulnerabilities, and global geopolitical and demand risks' among the challenges faced in the operating environment — directly relevant to an agri-input-based processor.
risks.risk: Commodity price volatility and supply chain vulnerability

risks.note: The MD&A's Structural Constraints section states that inadequate infrastructure disrupts business operations and limits access to broader markets and technologies, that high informality and underrepresentation of women in skilled employment waste human capital, and that trade and investment barriers hold back India's integration into global value chains.
risks.risk: Infrastructure and structural constraints in India

risks.note: Management cites 'weak IPR enforcement and a wide range of other regulatory and non-regulatory barriers to doing business in the country' as challenges common to developing economies that apply to its operating environment.
risks.risk: Regulatory and IPR-enforcement barriers to doing business

risks.note: The MD&A states that 2025 marked an inflection point, with policy overhauls across Western economies in trade, investment and industrial policy triggering spillover effects across all major global markets, and that India — intricately connected to global value chains — 'faced external shocks and acute effects from these global policy changes, including tariff escalations and volatile capital flows.'
risks.risk: Volatile capital flows and spillover from Western policy overhauls
